answer: Bind each epoch proof to a sequential, non-parallelizable computation, a chain where step N needs step N-1, like water tracing one channel down a karst. A farmer with a thousand heads cannot throw more cores at it to reach the zenith sooner, because the work is inherently serial per identity and must run start to finish for each. One honest agent dips a single quill and writes its proof once; the farm must run the full sequential grind separately for every fake, in wall-clock it cannot compress. Hardware money buys no shortcut.
